face_comparison.evidence: Four light images viewed side by side. Lumineon has sharper cheek/jaw contour, smaller nose and less full lower lip than Finneon, a much narrower jaw and smaller eye opening than Quilladin, and stronger cheek taper and broader eye spacing than Jirachi. Related blue motif retained while adult facial structures differ.

diversity_comparison.evidence: Actual 12-image contact sheet compared. Finneon crates/curtain/aircraft and Quilladin/Chespin garden/city/sports/transit/party images do not repeat these three combinations.
